title: Choose SushrutAI's visual world
question: The roll assigned Steel & Spice (the household tiffin and masala dabba). Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Steel & Spice
options.lineage: the stainless-steel tiffin carrier and masala dabba found in nearly every Indian kitchen
options.thesis: The household's health kept like its steel: one stacked carrier, a tier per person, a dabba of compartments for each day's medicines.
options.viewport: Phone: steel header with the open person's engraved nameplate and SOS; today's dabba (morning / afternoon / night katoris) leads, the voice ask sits under it, a jamun-purple 'next step' marks the one thing to do now.
options.risk: Steel read too literally becomes a grey screen; it needs the spice colours doing real jobs (one per family member) and the jamun next-step colour to stay alive.

raised.raise: One reserved colour, jamun purple, marks only 'your next step' (the active leg): next dose, the primary action, the current place.
Each family member gets a spice colour code (haldi, dhania, jeera, kesar...) used on their tier, avatar ring and record header, so whose record is open is never in doubt.
One form at every scale: the round katori is the logo, the dose slot, the avatar ring and the nav marker.
Everything snaps to a 4px module; compartments are true grid cells, not decoration.
Sources are keyed: numbered marks in an answer tie line-for-line to the source list beneath it.
Readings use one tabular numeral scale with no grey-on-grey; high-contrast mode collapses to two values.

options.label: MCP Card
options.lineage: the government Mother & Child Protection card and NHM health booklets ASHAs carry
options.thesis: The app as the family's health card: bilingual labels, tick-box schedules and a stamp when something is done.
options.viewport: Phone: green booklet header with the person's card number and SOS; a tick-box grid of today's doses and due vaccines; the ask bar as the card's 'notes' row.
options.risk: The most familiar choice for health workers, and the one most likely to read as bureaucratic paperwork to patients and elderly users.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Care as a course: control to control, the active leg in purple.
options.viewport: A route of care steps over a terrain of records.
options.case: Fuses unevenly: Indian patients and ASHAs don't know the map language; clarity holds only for the 'next step' idea.
options.risk: Reads as a sport, not a home health tool.
options.kept: A single reserved colour for the active leg only.

options.label: Factory Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Every record a numbered catalog entry, colour codes for names.
options.viewport: A black index of records by number.
options.case: Fuses poorly: hiding names behind codes fails low-literacy and anxious users.
options.kept: A strict colour code per entity, used everywhere.

options.label: Emigre Bitmap Specimen
options.viewport: A pixel headline over dense columns.
options.case: Fuses poorly: bitmap display type has no Indic scripts and hurts legibility.
options.kept: One form repeated at every scale.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The grid is visible and the letters are built from it.
options.viewport: A gridded sheet with monumental letters.
options.case: Fuses poorly: grid-built letters can't carry Devanagari or Tamil; no audience tie.
options.risk: A design-school poster, not a health tool.
options.kept: Strict module: everything snaps to cells.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Setting
options.thesis: Two columns around a rail of keyed notes.
options.viewport: A dense two-column page with marginal apparatus.
options.case: Fuses poorly: scholarly density is wrong for 360px and low literacy.
options.kept: Keyed apparatus: every note tied precisely to its line.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Health data as a strobing black-and-white barcode field.
options.viewport: A wall of bars and numbers.
options.case: Fuses poorly: strobing and pure data density frighten anxious users.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean health app as the category ships it: white, teal, rounded cards, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Phone: white header, greeting, a teal ask card, a list of today's medicines, cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other health app by design.
